we headed home.

(Right, I'm going to Deep Akihabara

Sorry!
I'm a little late.
Look at my feet.

rows.en:
Y-yeah, I suppose.
Well then, shall we go...
Mm, so yummy~
rows.notes: Reply to Kagura praising the maguro buns.

rows.en: Hm? Is something wrong?

Really? Isn't there something
you want to say?
What's this, all of a sudden?!

If that was a compliment, then thanks.
I'm kind of happy, actually.
Haha! I'm counting on you from here on too!
Same here. I'm counting on you too!
rows.notes: x3: also answers Ranka in scd_com_712/scd_fes_201 ('look out for me at school').

rows.en: (I wonder what's up with Kagura-kun...)
(I went out with Yuuto again today...)
Want to go to Nyan-Nyan after this?
Good idea, I'm getting hungry.
The maguro buns here are delicious.
I could eat a ton of these.

Oh, but are you okay with tuna, Yuuto?
Seems like you're a picky eater.

I'm not big on fish, but maguro buns
are a different story.
I knew it, you hate fish...
I mean, come on, hear me out...
We ended up talking for quite a while, huh.
Yeah. Sorry, I always do this to you.

I don't think you need to apologize.
I invite you because I want to talk
with you too, Yuuto.
I see. Then I'm glad.
rows.notes: x4: also the player in frd_myk_007 (Shirakawa says she got better); fits.

rows.en: Yeah, guess we should head home.
Yeah. See you at school.
(I wonder if I can still eat dinner...)
rows.notes: After filling up on maguro buns.

He's not showing up at all.
I wonder what happened...
Maybe I'll give him a call...
Hello, Yuuto?!

What is it, all of a sudden?
I'm kind of busy right now...
Um... Do you know what today is?

Sorry, I'm busy right now.
Could you save the quiz for later?

We were supposed to go out together today,
right? Remember?
Huh...?
Aaaaaaahhh!!!
I-I'm sorry!

No, let's set that aside for now.
What are you so busy with?
Actually, my mom came down with a fever...
Your mom?
Yeah, so I've been taking care of her...
I see. Well, that can't be helped.
Even so, I'm sorry I forgot our plans...
No, don't worry about that anymore.

Sorry to ask you something like this, but
what's good to feed someone who's sick?
Hmm, well, in that case...
rows.notes: Player's advice is cut by a scene jump.

rows.en: I see. Got it, I'll try making that!
Yeah. Hope she feels better soon.
rows.notes: 'Odaiji ni' aimed at Kagura's sick mother.

rows.en: I'll make this up to you another time...
Okay, got it.
rows.notes: x4: also frd_nns_004/005 (Nanase asks the player to wait / sets plans); fits.

rows.en: See you, then.

(Phew, it can't be helped if it's family
who's sick. Still, I wonder if Yuuto can
really take care of her properly...)
